image_description: A cluster of stylized, graffiti-covered street signs mounted on a single metal pole against a cloudy sky. The signs include a yellow directional arrow pointing left, a yellow irregular shape, a blue rectangular sign, and a red octagonal stop-sign shape at the bottom. All signs feature illegible, gibberish text that mimics typography but fails to form real words. The aesthetic is urban and artistic rather than functional.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Catastrophic failure of text generation. The characters are malformed, non-existent letters, and nonsensical strings. This is a hallmark AI artifact where the model mimics the shape of text without understanding orthography.

The physical attachment of the signs to the pole is logically inconsistent. Signs appear to float or merge into each other without visible mounting hardware. The yellow arrow sign seems to pass behind the yellow blob sign in a physically ambiguous way.
The arrow shape is warped and asymmetrical. The tail of the arrow does not align geometrically with the head, suggesting a slight melting or warping effect common in AI generations.
